title: Reliability watch
description: Reliability watch — provisioned openlaps endurance operations dashboard.

list.name: vehicle
list.label: Vehicle
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT vehicle_id AS __text, vehicle_id AS __value FROM v_samples_named WHERE $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY 1
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT vehicle_id AS __text, vehicle_id AS __value FROM v_samples_named WHERE $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY 1

list.name: session
list.label: Session
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(concat(left(session_id::text, 13), ' UTC ', session_type, ' at ', COALESCE(NULLIF(track_name, ''), 'unknown track')), 'unattributed') AS __text, COALESCE(session_id::text, 'unattributed') AS __value FROM v_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND $__timeFilter(crossed_at) ORDER BY 1
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(concat(left(session_id::text, 13), ' UTC ', session_type, ' at ', COALESCE(NULLIF(track_name, ''), 'unknown track')), 'unattributed') AS __text, COALESCE(session_id::text, 'unattributed') AS __value FROM v_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND $__timeFilter(crossed_at) ORDER BY 1

list.name: driver
list.label: Driver
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT driver AS __text, driver AS __value FROM v_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND driver IS NOT NULL AND ('$session' = 'all' OR session_id::text = '$session') AND $__timeFilter(crossed_at) ORDER BY 1
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT driver AS __text, driver AS __value FROM v_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND driver IS NOT NULL AND ('$session' = 'all' OR session_id::text = '$session') AND $__timeFilter(crossed_at) ORDER BY 1

list.name: stint
list.label: Stint
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT concat('Stint ', stint_number, ' — ', COALESCE(driver, 'unattributed')) AS __text, stint_number::text AS __value FROM v_laps WHERE '$session' <> 'all' AND session_id::text = '$session' AND stint_number IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT concat('Stint ', stint_number, ' — ', COALESCE(driver, 'unattributed')) AS __text, stint_number::text AS __value FROM v_laps WHERE '$session' <> 'all' AND session_id::text = '$session' AND stint_number IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

list.name: lap
list.label: Lap
list.definition: SELECT concat('Lap ', lap_number, ' — ', COALESCE(driver, 'unattributed'), ' — ', to_char(crossed_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) AS __text, lap_id::text AS __value FROM v_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND ('$session' = 'all' OR session_id::text = '$session') AND ('$driver' = 'all' OR driver = '$driver') AND $__timeFilter(crossed_at) ORDER BY crossed_at
list.query: SELECT concat('Lap ', lap_number, ' — ', COALESCE(driver, 'unattributed'), ' — ', to_char(crossed_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) AS __text, lap_id::text AS __value FROM v_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND ('$session' = 'all' OR session_id::text = '$session') AND ('$driver' = 'all' OR driver = '$driver') AND $__timeFilter(crossed_at) ORDER BY crossed_at

panels.title: Firing alerts
panels.description: Every rule in the openlaps folder that is firing right now, wherever you are looking. Acknowledge on the annunciator (notifier, port 8086); this strip shows, it does not silence.

panels.title: Oil pressure against RPM envelope

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, max(CASE WHEN channel = 'car.rpm' THEN avg END) AS "RPM", min(CASE WHEN channel = 'car.oil_pressure' THEN min END) * 0.145038 AS "Oil pressure minimum", max(CASE WHEN channel = 'car.oil_pressure' THEN max END) * 0.145038 AS "Oil pressure maximum" FROM (SELECT * FROM v_samples_1m_named WHERE $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz > interval '1 hour' UNION ALL SELECT * FROM v_samples_1s_named WHERE $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz <= interval '1 hour') src WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND channel IN ('car.oil_pressure','car.rpm') AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.description: One-second detail when the time range is an hour or less, one-minute aggregates beyond that. Oil pressure is gauge pressure in psi.

panels.title: Coolant temperature

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, avg - 273.15 AS "Average", min - 273.15 AS "Minimum", max - 273.15 AS "Maximum" FROM (SELECT * FROM v_samples_1m_named WHERE $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz > interval '1 hour' UNION ALL SELECT * FROM v_samples_1s_named WHERE $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz <= interval '1 hour') src WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND channel = 'car.coolant_temp' AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time

panels.description: Stored samples are Kelvin (see docs/CATALOG.md); the query subtracts 273.15 so the axis reads in °C. One-second detail when the time range is an hour or less, one-minute aggregates beyond that.

panels.title: Oil temperature

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, avg - 273.15 AS "Average", min - 273.15 AS "Minimum", max - 273.15 AS "Maximum" FROM (SELECT * FROM v_samples_1m_named WHERE $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz > interval '1 hour' UNION ALL SELECT * FROM v_samples_1s_named WHERE $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz <= interval '1 hour') src WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND channel = 'car.oil_temp' AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time

panels.description: Stored samples are Kelvin (see docs/CATALOG.md); the query subtracts 273.15 so the axis reads in °C. One-second detail when the time range is an hour or less, one-minute aggregates beyond that.

panels.title: Gearbox oil temperature

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, avg - 273.15 AS "Average", min - 273.15 AS "Minimum", max - 273.15 AS "Maximum" FROM (SELECT * FROM v_samples_1m_named WHERE $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz > interval '1 hour' UNION ALL SELECT * FROM v_samples_1s_named WHERE $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz <= interval '1 hour') src WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND channel = 'car.gearbox_oil_temp' AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time

panels.description: Stored samples are Kelvin (see docs/CATALOG.md); the query subtracts 273.15 so the axis reads in °C. One-second detail when the time range is an hour or less, one-minute aggregates beyond that.

panels.title: Knock counts and protection events

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, sum(CASE WHEN channel IN ('car.knock_level1','car.knock_level2') AND max > 0 THEN count ELSE 0 END) AS "Knock count", max(CASE WHEN channel = 'car.engine_protection_severity' THEN max END) AS "Protection severity" FROM (SELECT * FROM v_samples_1m_named WHERE $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz > interval '1 hour' UNION ALL SELECT * FROM v_samples_1s_named WHERE $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz <= interval '1 hour') src WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND channel IN ('car.knock_level1','car.knock_level2','car.engine_protection_severity') AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.description: One-second detail when the time range is an hour or less, one-minute aggregates beyond that.

panels.title: PDM circuit currents

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, max(CASE WHEN channel IN ('car.pd16_total_current') THEN avg END) AS "PDM total", max(CASE WHEN channel IN ('car.thermo_fan_1_current') THEN avg END) AS "Thermo fan", max(CASE WHEN channel IN ('car.ign_coils_current') THEN avg END) AS "Ignition coils", max(CASE WHEN channel IN ('car.head_light_current') THEN avg END) AS "Head lights" FROM (SELECT * FROM v_samples_1m_named WHERE $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz > interval '1 hour' UNION ALL SELECT * FROM v_samples_1s_named WHERE $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz <= interval '1 hour') src WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND channel IN ('car.pd16_total_current','car.thermo_fan_1_current','car.ign_coils_current','car.head_light_current') AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.description: PDM total, thermo fan, head lights and the coils output (25A-HCO3, Coils/Deutsch). Pumps are on the chart alongside. One-second detail when the time range is an hour or less, one-minute aggregates beyond that.

panels.title: PDM pump currents

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, max(CASE WHEN channel IN ('car.fuel_pump_current') THEN avg END) AS "Fuel pump", max(CASE WHEN channel IN ('car.lift_pump_current') THEN avg END) AS "Lift pump", max(CASE WHEN channel IN ('car.gearbox_pump_current') THEN avg END) AS "Gearbox pump", max(CASE WHEN channel IN ('car.cam_scavenge_pump_current', 'car.oil_pump_current') THEN avg END) AS "Cam scavenge pump", max(CASE WHEN channel IN ('car.power_steering_pump_1_current') THEN avg END) AS "Power steering 1", max(CASE WHEN channel IN ('car.power_steering_pump_2_current') THEN avg END) AS "Power steering 2", max(CASE WHEN channel IN ('car.water_injection_pump_current', 'car.inj_current') THEN avg END) AS "Water injection pump" FROM (SELECT * FROM v_samples_1m_named WHERE $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz > interval '1 hour' UNION ALL SELECT * FROM v_samples_1s_named WHERE $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz <= interval '1 hour') src WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND channel IN ('car.fuel_pump_current','car.lift_pump_current','car.gearbox_pump_current','car.cam_scavenge_pump_current','car.oil_pump_current','car.power_steering_pump_1_current','car.power_steering_pump_2_current','car.water_injection_pump_current','car.inj_current') AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.description: Every pump on the PDM, named as in the Haltech wiring report. Cam scavenge and water injection also read their pre-rename channels, so history from before 13 Nov still shows. One-second detail when the time range is an hour or less, one-minute aggregates beyond that.

panels.title: Engine protection reason and check-engine events

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, max(CASE WHEN channel = 'car.engine_protection_severity' THEN max END) AS "Protection severity", max(CASE WHEN channel = 'car.engine_protection_reason_number' THEN max END) AS "Protection reason number", max(CASE WHEN channel = 'car.engine_protection_reason_letter' THEN max END) AS "Protection reason letter", max(CASE WHEN channel = 'car.check_engine_light' THEN max END) AS "Check engine light" FROM (SELECT * FROM v_samples_1m_named WHERE $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz > interval '1 hour' UNION ALL SELECT * FROM v_samples_1s_named WHERE $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz <= interval '1 hour') src WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND channel IN ('car.engine_protection_severity','car.engine_protection_reason_number','car.engine_protection_reason_letter','car.check_engine_light') AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.description: One-second detail when the time range is an hour or less, one-minute aggregates beyond that.
